heading: Declaration callback
text:
### Declaration callback [NSTG.5.5]

Fires at DSC load, **once per persisted series** — a series without
`persist:` never reaches this callback. It is the manifest a backend
needs to provision storage before the first sample arrives.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| schema_name / slot_name | which series is being declared |
| identity_slot_name | how it partitions; **empty under `by: none`**, matching [NSTG.5.3] |
| storage_mode | accumulator, or ring buffer |
| element_type | the element's type; always float for an accumulator |
| window_ns | the window; **zero means unwindowed** |
| persist_ns | the retention, always positive — it is what made this series persisted at all |

The storage mode is the field that decides provisioning: an accumulator
keeps one running value per instance, a ring buffer keeps a bounded
sequence, and those want different backing shapes. The enum is
deliberately open for future modes, so a receiver should reject an
unrecognised mode rather than assume one of the two.

The callback signature will be `ds_series_declared_cb_t`, the declaration
struct `ds_series_declaration_t`, and the storage-mode enum
`ds_series_storage_mode_t` (`DS_SERIES_ACCUMULATOR` /
`DS_SERIES_RING_BUFFER`), declared in `runtime/include/libds.h` when this
section binds. Nothing declares them in this edition.
